The -114 price requires approximately 53.3% wins before accounting for pushes, which cannot occur at 59.5. No model probability or simulated median is claimed.

pre_mortem: It is Monday and the under lost because Denver stayed ahead or competitive enough to feed Dobbins substantially more than his recent workload. SF's three-game defensive sample overstated its resistance, or one explosive run supplied the missing yardage. Missing offensive-line and injury information could also conceal a material matchup change. Those risks keep this a lean rather than a strong selection.
